The error occurs because the `quote` crate needs to be added to your project's dependencies in the `Cargo.toml` file.

To fix this, run the following command in your terminal (in the same directory as your `Cargo.toml`):

```bash
cargo add quote
```

After running that, `cargo check` and `cargo run` will work perfectly. 

### Why did this happen?
The `syn` crate is great for parsing Rust code into an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST), but converting those AST nodes back into normal strings requires its sister crate, `quote`, which provides the `ToTokens` trait. Adding `quote` allows the `.to_token_stream().to_string()` method to compile.
